clue.text: Children may be found playing it

definitions.text: Children may be found playing it

parts.words: Children may be found playing it
parts.note: a game in which children are found is literally what the game consists of: some conceal themselves and one searches

explanation.surface: A remark about what children get up to at play.
explanation.walkthrough: The joke is that 'may be found' is the whole point of the game: the players are trying not to be found.
explanation.definitionFit: A classic children's game where one player searches for the others who have concealed themselves.

clue.text: Trickster admitting his image?

explanation.definitionFit: An icon is a picture or likeness, especially a religious painting venerated in the Orthodox church.

clue.text: Suffers, made to conclude certain changes are needed

explanation.definitionFit: To endure is to bear or put up with hardship, so the two verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: One is distracted by northern light

clue.text: Calms frequently seen on board

explanation.definitionFit: To soften someone is to calm or mollify them; both verbs mean to make less harsh.

clue.text: Poor consolation that's found in a luxury igloo?
